correctness.rationale: The universal online upper bound fixes a queried assignment edge and reduces the board order. An explicit eight-leaf tree establishes the only difficult order-four base; a two-competing-edge argument inducts through all smaller forbidden matchings and the fully forbidden diagonal. Hall's theorem independently establishes the cited VC boundary; the size-two/three/four cases were enumerated and their proof boundaries examined. verify.py checked every rank through size five, the order-six derangements, and every potentially shattered matching support through size five.

value.rationale: A complete exact two-parameter online-rank classification reveals a discrete VC/Littlestone phase transition at the deletion of the final forbidden assignment position. The exceptional four-by-four witness is structurally necessary, and the induction constructs adversarial mistake trees for all larger sizes. This is an interpretable assignment-learning invariant, not a routine recount of derangements or an arbitrary finite computation.
